Every field is completely blank and smooth inside so text can be printed later. Painted comic-book illustration with the finish of a premium collectible: hand-painted materials, crisp black ink contour lines, one warm key light from the top, a faint green rim light along the left edge and a faint red rim light along the right edge. Viewed perfectly flat and head-on, orthographic, no perspective, no tilt. The object fills the entire image edge to edge, no background visible. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no digits, no words, no logos, no symbols, no faces, no people, no portraits, no eagles, no animals, no buildings.
